country.title: Country
country.description: Country of the Budget Lines, e.g. Kenya. The authoritative filter. Required.

dimensionName.title: Dimension Name
dimensionName.description: Optional dimension for dimensionValue — Department, Cost Category, Cost Type, Sub-Unit, or Business Unit. Pass when the user is explicit (e.g. 'Department = Market Access'); leave blank to auto-detect (the action asks if the value is ambiguous).

dimensionValue.title: Dimension Value
dimensionValue.description: DIMENSION MODE: an explicit lower-level Budget Line value the user named that is NOT a standard program, e.g. Crop Insurance, Staff Costs, Field Operations. Pass ONLY when the user asks about a specific dimension/item. Combine with program to segment a standard program.

extraDimensionName.title: Extra Dimension Name
extraDimensionName.description: Optional dimension name for the second value.

extraDimensionValue.title: Extra Dimension Value
extraDimensionValue.description: Optional second explicit dimension value for a combined filter (e.g. Department = Market Access AND Cost Category = Staff Costs).

fiscalYear.title: Fiscal Year
fiscalYear.description: Fiscal year, e.g. 2027. Defaults to the current scenario when omitted.

partOfRange.title: Part Of Range
partOfRange.description: Set true ONLY when this call is one year of an explicit multi-year RANGE the user asked for (e.g. '2027 to 2030'), so the per-year next-available-year lookahead is suppressed and you compose the year-by-year answer yourself. Leave blank/false for a single-year question — then, when that year has no available Headroom, the action automatically reports the next future year that does.

program.title: Program
program.description: PROGRAM MODE: the standard Headroom category the user named (Core Program, Rural Retail, Market Access, Trees, System Change Extension, Unrestricted, Working Capital). Pass a standard program here. LEAVE BLANK for a pure dimension query.
